messages.subject: Error SWATbuildR channel connectivity
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,
I have an issue when SWATbuildR tries to connect channel network.
This is the error on R :

Analyzing connectivity of water object network...  ✘  23 channel segments identified not connected to other channels or reservoirs.  ✔  No disconnected reservoirs identified.
Erreur dans check_cha_res_connectivity(data_path, id_cha_out, id_res_out) : Connectivity issues for the water objects identified! Writing the layer water_connectivity_issues.gpkg into '../../Temp/buildr_project/Mini_CREATE/data/vector' Load the .gpkg layer in a GIS to analyze the features that cause issues. Fix the issues in the land and channel layers before proceeding with the model setup.

On QGIS, the channel starting point and end point are generated in the wrong direction. And unless, we took care about the line stream network direction are correctly oriented from upstream to downstream. You can find the screenshot of my basin :

Thanks in advance for your help.

Léna Fouque
Toulouse University
